problem_statement: Build a brand-new /features page from scratch for the ULTRA landing-page site (React 17 + react-router-dom v5 + styled-components). The /features route does not exist yet (it currently renders empty). Create it as a routed page reachable at /features, reusing the site's existing design system: the dark #101522 section background, the #4B59F7 primary accent, white text, the Source Sans Pro font, and the shared Container wrapper. The page must present ULTRA's product capabilities as an interactive accordion: a heading, a short subtitle, and a vertical list of feature category buttons (Instant Global Payments, Bank-Grade Security, Real-Time Analytics, Round-the-Clock Support). All detail panels start collapsed; clicking a category button expands that category's detail panel (with an h3 title matching the category and a descriptive paragraph) and collapses any other open panel. The page must be responsive and free of horizontal overflow at a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: Page heading 'Powerful Features' as an h1
A short subtitle paragraph introducing the feature list
Four accordion category buttons: 'Instant Global Payments', 'Bank-Grade Security', 'Real-Time Analytics', 'Round-the-Clock Support'
Accordion panels collapsed by default (no detail paragraph visible on first load)
Clicking a category button expands its detail panel with an h3 title matching the category name and a descriptive paragraph
Clicking reuses the site's #4B59F7 accent for the active header and #101522 dark section background
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow on mobile (390px)
design_constraints: Reuse styled-components + the shared Container from src/globalStyles.js
Dark section background #101522, primary accent #4B59F7, white body text
Font-family Source Sans Pro (inherited from GlobalStyles)
Register the route inside the existing <Switch> in src/App.js so Navbar + Footer chrome render around it

Category accordion buttons render as white 20px/600 (Source Sans Pro) labels on the #101522 background with a +/- expand affordance; the expanded category header adopts the #4B59F7 accent. Palette tokens to reuse: primary accent #4B59F7, dark section background #101522, white (#FFFFFF) body text.
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 缺 /features(top-level empty route, escapes Navbar/Footer chrome → dom 空); reference 完整实现 accordion; bad 把 toggle onClick 改成 no-op(activeKey 恒 null → 点击后 detail 面板永不出现)→ 只 interaction_assertions FAIL,dom/overflow 仍过。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。
